name: Keyframe Optimization
description: Keyframe editing optimizations for BBS 2.7: restores the 2.5.2 gizmo display modes (T toggle, G/S/R first-press switch), optional two-axis planes in single modes, a hold-to-bypass tick snapping key for the timeline, auto limb keyframes in the replay editor, Blender-style pose summary tracks, and batch value edits over marquee-selected keyframes.
